narr: Strong thunderstorm activity developed over the San Diego Mountains during the afternoon hours on the 11th, likely instigated by large-scale forcing for ascent from an upper-level low located to the south. Outflows from the initial thunderstorm complex over the San Diego mountains helped to initialize new activity across western Imperial County. With PWAT values of around 2.0 inches, conditions were favorable for heavy rainfall producing thunderstorms.
ev: Video showing flash flooding in multiple spots along Split Mountain Rd, with most significant flooding at the Fish Creek Wash crossing. The road was washed out at this point and floodwaters were reportedly as deep as 4-6 feet based on sediment flow and depth of the wash. No injuries were reported.
SR-98 closed between Imperial Highway and Brockman Road due to flooding with several vehicles hydroplaning on the road. No damages nor injuries were reported.
